expected.summary: No Designer runs: starts Designer through the Xpedition launcher with the practice project open; the new session (owned) is found in the session list.

rows.reason: session open always starts one new instance; there is no call with nothing to start.

expected.summary: The file is neither a project (.prj) nor a board (.pcb); refused before anything starts.
No file at that path; nothing starts.

rows.reason: session open names no existing instance or object; it starts a new instance, so nothing can match several.

session open has no target to lock and names no open document, so no runtime conflict applies; a Designer or Layout already running is refused by the adapter as E_VALIDATION (one instance only, knowledge designer-one-instance-only).

expected.summary: Run under a scope file that does not grant the lifecycle effect; nothing starts.

rows.reason: session open calls no running instance: an instance of the same program already running is refused before anything starts (E_VALIDATION), so the call is never held by a busy one.
session open calls no running instance, so no dialog in one can block the call; a prompt in the new instance is reported in the new session's state (blocked) in the result.

expected.summary: The new Designer process ends while it is starting; nothing is left running.

rows.unrunnable: The new process cannot be made to end on demand at the moment the adapter waits for it to register.

rows.reason: session open opens a file in a new instance; the adapter keeps unsaved changes per running session, and the new one has none.

The read-back is the new session in the session list; the adapter builds the receipt's session and the list's from the same process ID and start time, and start fails with E_NATIVE_FAILURE when that process ends, so there is no stored value that can differ.
